name: crystallized-anthem-marks-each-unit-you-control
notes: Crystallized Anthem: the damage-prevention shield on each unit you control used to never be applied (the effect never ran).

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Crystallized Anthem's effect was generated as an $enterAbilities entry, but it is an Action that never enters the field, so activating it only paid its cost and sent it to the graveyard: the effect never ran. Fix: OnCardActivated() runs an Action's enter ability as its resolution effect when the card has no activation ability of its own.
